It ranks with BM25F, weighting fields like title above body, and returns Search Facets natively as part of its index response — never touching the Postgres Search Vector. So Search runs two engines — Postgres for the always-on baseline, Indx for forgiving fuzzy retrieval — and the Did You Mean and Auto Correction Loop features lean on its tolerance. Both engines are scored side by side by the Golden Eval harness, which keeps their relevance trade-offs honest.

Indx is wired through the retriever seam rather than the plugin registry, but it shares the off-by-default discipline of the Plugin Behaviour family: with Indx absent, Search falls back to Postgres Search and Barkpark still works.
